findings.summary: Claim: y_n = (1 + \sqrt{2})^n in kappa = Q(\sqrt{2}) has |y_n|_{v_1} / |y_n|_{v_2} = (1 + \sqrt{2})^{2n} -> infty as n -> infty, so no such constant c(kappa) exists independent of y (or x). Moreover, y is not even a unit, and multiplying by a unit would alter x'Q(x). (This erroneous deduction is used to conclude m(y, 0) = O(1), which would trivially imply the abc conjecture.)
